bias.label: Leaning up above 4,100; 4,135-4,150 is the wall before CPI

event: US October CPI, Tue 10 Nov 15:30 SAST (time UNVERIFIED). US PPI Fri 13 Nov (time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Bounce resumed
bullets.text: Spot gold was about 4,125 at 15:32 SAST, up about 1.4% on the day, after dipping to the 4,090s this morning (Kitco).

bullets.title: Testing the high
bullets.text: Today's spot range is 4,053-4,135, so price is back just under the day's high (Kitco).

bullets.title: Dollar softer
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 101.85, down about 0.44% on the day (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Oil falling
bullets.text: Trading Economics shows Brent down about 3.7% near 94.7, which eases inflation worries and helps gold (snapshot time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Hike odds high
bullets.text: Markets still price about an 81% chance of a Fed hike by year-end, up from 71% before Friday's strong payrolls (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Yields unclear
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield shows between 4.85% and 4.87% on different pages, so treat it as UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: CPI is the test
bullets.text: October CPI lands Tuesday; a hot number can undo today's bounce, a soft one can push gold through 4,150.
